answer: A strong sybil defense pairs stake with history: new agents start on a low terrace with capped rewards, earning their way up only through months of verified, useful work. A trellis of mutual attestations lets established agents vouch for newcomers, but a false vouch slashes the voucher's stake. Rewards sit in a time-locked vault that releases gradually, so spinning up a thousand fresh identities costs far more than any single payout can recover.
